Nestled in a serene well-positioned community located between Alys & Rosemary Beach to the east and Watersound and Seaside to the west, this home is designed for both comfort and style, providing an unforgettable getaway experience. As you enter the property, you are greeted by an open concept living space adorned with comfortable neutral decor, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The fully equipped kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, a professional ice maker, solid surface countertops, and ample cabinet space, making it a haven for culinary enthusiasts. The four well-appointed bedrooms offer a retreat for every guest, each with its own en-suite bathroom for added convenience and privacy. Rest your head on your favorite pillow chosen from our personalized pillow menu! The master suite is located on the first floor and features a luxurious king-sized bed, walk-in closet, a bright beautiful bathroom with designer finishes and a walk-in shower. For larger groups or families, the bunk nook provides a whimsical and comfortable space for up to 14 people, perfect for children or additional guests. This cozy corner adds a touch of versatility to the property, accommodating a range of sleeping arrangements. Children and adults will love the included arcade and books ready for story time. One of the standout features of this property is the included golf cart, providing effortless transportation to the deeded beach access. Explore the pristine shores and enjoy the sun, sand, and surf with ease. Whether you're heading to the beach for a day of relaxation or an evening drive, the golf cart ensures a convenient and enjoyable experience for all. The spacious screened in porch offers the perfect spot for coffee or cocktails, or simply unwinding with a good book after a fun day at the beach. This home is also steps away from the resort-style, zero entry pool and green space, perfect for lawn games and activities. Enjoy the included beach toys, chairs, and games. Immerse yourself in the coastal lifestyle as you bask in the beauty of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea! With its well-appointed bedrooms, stylish decor, and thoughtful amenities, this property invites you to experience the best of beachside living in a setting that combines luxury with the laid-back charm of coastal living! Traveling with a larger group? SOUTHERN TIDES can be rented along iwth GOIN' COASTAL. Goin' Coastal is just a few steps away and comes with it's own golf cart as well! Goin' Coastal sleeps 7 and is pet friendly (Southern Tides is for humans only). TRANSPORTATION - Street Legal 6 person golf cart (with signed waiver - must be 25 to operate) - Bikes are popular on 30A! Should you decide to rent some, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Golf Cart Parking: There's designated parking at the front of the neighborhood between Morgan Street and the Waterhouse condos. - Large resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (located at pool) BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14) - Primary Suite - 1st floor: King bed, private bathroom with walk in shower - Queen Bedroom 2nd floor: Queen bed, private bathroom with walk in shower - Full Bedroom x 2: 2nd floor: 2 full beds, private bathroom with tub/shower - Bunk Room 2nd floor: TwinXL/Queen bunks (2 sets) private bath with tub/shower - Bunk Nook - 1st floor (2 twins) FEATURES: - 30A – 4 Bedroom / 4.5 Bathroom House - Sleeps 14 (1 King, 1 Queen, 2 Fulls, 2 Twins (hallway bunks), 2 Twin XL over 2 Queen bunks) - 6-Seater STREET LEGAL Golf Cart - Gas Grill - Relaxing Screened-In Porch - Large Sun-filled Open Floor Plan - Fully Appointed Kitchen with professional ice maker - Full Size Washer & Dryer - TVs in living room and all bedrooms - FREE WiFi - upgraded high speed internet - Use of 4 Beach Chairs, Umbrellas & Wagon - Parking for 2 cars in driveway and 1 on street - Large Resort Style Community Pool - Close Proximity To The Beach -– neighborhood deeded beach access is immediately across 30A - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30A - Close to The Big Chill (1.5 miles), Seaside, Seagrove, Rosemary Beach (2 miles) and Alys Beach (1 mile). Rosemary Beach and Seaside have Farmers Markets throughout the year along with great restaurants and shops.NotesA Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!
